prompt: A car wash serves $X$ cars per hour, where $X$ has mean $12$ and standard deviation $3$. Each car brings in $\$8$, and the hourly cost of running the wash is $\$20$, so hourly profit is $Y = 8X - 20$. What is the mean of $Y$, in dollars?
hint: For $Y = aX + b$, the mean transforms the same way: $\mu_Y = a\mu_X + b$.

hints.text: For $Y = aX + b$, the mean transforms the same way: $\mu_Y = a\mu_X + b$.

explanation: Multiplying every value of $X$ by $8$ multiplies the mean by $8$: $8 \times 12 = 96$.
Subtracting $20$ from every value lowers the mean by $20$: $96 - 20 = 76$.
So the mean hourly profit is $\$76$. (The standard deviation $3$ was not needed for the mean.)

alternativeExplanations.title: A typical hour
steps: In a typical hour, 12 cars come through.
Because the rule $8X - 20$ is linear, the "typical hour" calculation gives exactly the mean of $Y$.
